meta.source: Built from the genesis folder: thegenesis.art verify page CSS, Moment Finder prototype, business-card print spec, Set A/B artifacts, Recognition Record 2620050a artwork.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night: THE GENESIS brand surfaces, the art, the witness (from the live site). Vellum: the ritual and the person's own words: Moment Finder, manifesto, certificates (from the prototype's cream).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on ground: witness record, concept cards, choice chips. Night value matches the Endless artwork canvas so art sits seamlessly.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered surface; quiet emphasis blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark on ground, surface and surface-raised (15.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ledes, supporting lines on ground and surfaces (≥5.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, footnotes, witness labels on ground and surface (≥4.75:1 in both themes). Never for sentences people must read to decide.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The only accent. Eyebrows, dates, short rules, links and the focus ring on ground and surfaces (≥5:1 in both themes). Night value is the live site's gold #D4A657; Vellum is deepened from the prototype's #9C7A3C, which reads 3.5:1 and fails small text.

tokens.name: brass-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action (Find your moment). Vellum value is the site's brand gold #B88A42.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on brass-fill (8.4:1 night, 6.0:1 vellum). Never white on brass.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (choice chips, inputs) and outlines that must be seen: ≥3.3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset.

tokens.name: witness-valid
tokens.usage: The word 'Signed', 'Anchored' or 'Stored' when a proof is confirmed. Always paired with the word and a mark, never colour alone (≥5:1 on surfaces).

tokens.name: witness-pending
tokens.usage: A proof still pending (e.g. Bitcoin anchor awaiting confirmation). Always paired with the word 'Pending'.

tokens.name: art-ground
tokens.usage: Canvas behind generative artworks, sampled from the Endless engine output. Frames artwork in both themes.

tokens.name: art-verdant
tokens.usage: The Endless 'Verdant' palette's pale green filaments. Diagrams of the seed-to-form process only; never UI chrome.

tokens.name: art-cyan
tokens.usage: Endless cyan filaments. Process diagrams and art-adjacent motifs only.

tokens.name: art-violet
tokens.usage: Endless violet filaments. Process diagrams and art-adjacent motifs only.

families.label: Jost, "Futura", "Century Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: turn
styles.sample: You can tell anyone what you built.
styles.usage: One line per screen on the home page's four turns. Max two per viewport; never more than 14 words.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles and the handoff line.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: A witness that can't be changed.
styles.usage: Section titles, the recognition title on a share card.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.sample: Recognition: to know again what was already true.
styles.usage: A definition or an old word, set once per page.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name, uppercase, widely tracked, as on the brand card. Only in the Wordmark lockup.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Every transformation begins with something ending.
styles.usage: The line under a title; the person's own quoted words.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It is not a picture of what happened. It is made the way transformation happens.
styles.usage: Running text: manifesto, offering pages, concept cards.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Private stories are encrypted in your browser. Only you hold the key.
styles.usage: Dense text: FAQs, witness explanations, card bodies.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title, in brass. Two to four words.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Four small choices. About five minutes.
styles.usage: Microcopy under actions, image captions, nav links.

styles.name: record
styles.usage: Hashes, keys, transaction IDs, recognition IDs. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, mark-to-word in witness status.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between eyebrow and title; chip inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked labels and values in the witness record.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; card internal gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; space between paragraphs and actions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between a title block and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page; desktop gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below a section on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Above and below a section on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Breathing room between turns on the home scroll; one line, then silence.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and choice chips: near-square, like a printed card's edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Concept cards and the witness record panel (the live site's 0.5rem).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The artwork frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The outer edge of a recognition share card.

shadow.note: The system is lit by contrast, not by shadow. One shadow exists, for the artwork alone.

tokens.name: shadow-art
tokens.usage: Under the artwork frame only, so the piece lifts off the page like a hung work.

tokens.name: measure-turn
tokens.usage: Max width of a turn line, so it breaks into one or two lines.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.
